title: Commit 5983353: a font bug, tall layout, and diff highlights

intro.say: One commit, three changes: a font bug fixed, tall videos centred, and a cleaner highlight on diffs.

chapters.title: Text measured with the wrong font
chapters.say: Why was quoted text spilling into the captions?

scenes.heading: Before: six fonts, loaded by name

beats.say: The author describes the bug this way: quoted text was fitted with a fallback font, and came out the wrong size once the real one arrived.
Here is the old code. Before measuring anything, it waited for a fixed list of six font faces.

items.label: faces the old code waited for

beats.say: Six faces were on that list, but the stylesheet declares eight.
Instead, it asks the page for every font it declares, and waits for all of them.
So a block is never sized with a font that is about to be replaced.

scenes.heading: Centre what was built
scenes.expect: // A tall frame has height to spare.

beats.say: A tall frame now centres the header and its block together, instead of leaving them at the top.
It plugs in right after a scene is built, and it skips title cards.
It measures the space left above the captions, and moves everything down by a little under half of it.
With sixty pixels of room or less, it leaves the layout alone.

chapters.title: A cleaner highlight on diffs
chapters.say: The last change is two lines of styling.

columns.title: Before
points: A second tint on top of the row
It muddied the green and red

columns.title: After
points: The row keeps its own colour

beats.say: On a diff, rows already carry colour, so a highlight that tints them again muddies both.
Now the highlight is an outline, and the green and red stay clean.
